facts: Owner decisions (2026-11-22): both Bollinger variants, gross of cost (the gold cache has no spread), HAR/HAR-X/LightGBM/MLP for the range, and the dollar index (MT5 hourly for Part 2, Yahoo daily for Part 1).

Gold H1 2015-2026 was already used by the gold family (validation and one-shot test blocks): its D1/H1 volatility LSTMs CLEARED against GARCH and its range intervals were DROP. Neither scored band events or the NY session range.

Currency precedents: fx-bb-reversion and fx-bb-sma-exit DROP on six pairs; fx-ny-volatility LightGBM KEEP for both pairs and the descriptive HAR-X beat LightGBM and the MLP, which is why HAR-X is registered here; fx-ny-orb-hot DROP.

Before this pre-registration only event counts, bar presence, the DXY clock and gaps were looked at (179 first breaches 2015-2026 measured before the plan). No gold outcome, exit or target was computed.
The MT5 contract USDIndDec26 expires on 2026-12-11; its cache is pinned by digest and never refetched.

cells.gold_bb_lightgbm_vs_base_rate: mean log-loss of the walk-forward LightGBM below the fit-slice base rate of r > 0
cells.gold_bb_rule_mean_reversion: mean r = dir * (close[t+3] - close[t]) / ATR20 > 0 over every event with an outcome

cells.gold_bb_sma_lightgbm_vs_base_rate: mean log-loss of the walk-forward LightGBM below the fit-slice base rate of R > 0
cells.gold_bb_sma_rule_mean_r: mean R > 0 over every opened trade with an exit

cells.gold_harx_vs_har: mean squared error of y: HAR-X below HAR
cells.gold_lgbm_vs_harx: mean squared error of y: LightGBM below HAR-X
cells.gold_mlp_vs_harx: mean squared error of y: 5-seed MLP below HAR-X
